title: Agency posting where the client is already known at intake: file it under the client, or under the agency?
detail: Your 10-13 agency rule has two parts that disagree in one case. Item 1: a client named in the posting (or found by two quick searches) is the employer, so the row is filed under the client. Item 3: an agency posting and the client's own posting are separate opportunities and must never be merged. Filed under the client, the Writer can match the agency posting to the client's own posting as the same row, merging the two avenues you said are distinct. Lanes keep doing item 1 until you rule.
blocks: Nothing stops; it decides whether agency and client postings can collapse into one row.
options: COMPANY = agency, client recorded in CLIENT_EMPLOYER (keeps both avenues separate)
recommended: COMPANY = agency with CLIENT_EMPLOYER: it guarantees the two avenues stay separate rows, which is what item 3 protects.
action: Answer in chat; Claude updates the agency rule packet through a PR you merge.
